summary: Mixed legal and retail day with regulatory focus on derivatives trading risks and competitive M&A activity. Reliance to raise $1.3bn in rupee bonds; Adidas cutting 350+ India Tech Hub jobs.

bullets.text: Sebi Chief Pandey: regulatory measures reduced aggregate F&O losses, but individual traders continue losing money despite interventions.
Reliance to raise $1.3 billion in first rupee bond sale since 2023, signaling capital markets access amid refinancing activity.
Adidas initiates layoffs at India Tech Hub in Gurgaon affecting over 350 employees amid global workforce restructuring.
Oriflame's CEO targets India for 25% of global revenue by 2030, signaling aggressive market expansion in beauty retail.
BharatPe endorses new UPI MDR framework, distancing itself from founder Ashneer Grover's individual remarks on policy.
